data.description: On the Leg Press Cum Standing Twister, one user sits and pushes the footplates of the leg press while another stands on the twister and turns the hips from side to side. The two movements suit different people: the leg press for strength in the thighs, the twister for gentle waist mobility. It is a practical two-user machine for a society, a corporate campus or a walking track. The machine is finished in Play Orange. Size and warranty details are part of the quotation we send. For the Leg Press Cum Standing Twister, our sales team will confirm cover; standard terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings. Share your site details for a layout.

items.pText: On the Leg Press Cum Standing Twister, one user sits and pushes the footplates of the leg press while another stands on the twister and turns the hips from side to side. The two movements suit different people: the leg press for strength in the thighs, the twister for gentle waist mobility. It is a practical two-user machine for a society, a corporate campus or a walking track. The machine is finished in Play Orange. Size and warranty details are part of the quotation we send. For the Leg Press Cum Standing Twister, our sales team will confirm cover; standard terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings. Share your site details for a layout.

The twister platform turns on a bearing and the leg press arm on pivots, so both need regular checks. We install this pair self-standing or grouted. Position it so the twister user faces away from a walkway, and leave clear space in front of the footplates.
